description: This file is a module that manages test file paths and configurations for different channel-related tests in a project. It imports modules for path manipulation and defines functions and constants to categorize, include, exclude, and override test files based on their paths and naming conventions.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Converts file paths to a normalized form with forward slashes

methods.name: isChannelSurfaceTestFile
methods.description: Checks if a given file path is a channel surface test file based on predefined path prefixes and override sets
